home.body:
Sohojogita

Mukhya bishoygulir shongkhipto byakha.

A

Atheism

Devtader dabi guli protyakhan kora hoyeche, karon porishkharjoggo byobosthit tothyo nei. Eta kothin obokaloner upor bhitti kore dhormiyo kothaboli ke kalponik ba byobosthit shotti hishebe dekhe, obyabaharik tothyer poriborte

Khulun
P

Philosophy

Ostitter, gyaner, mull, karon, mon, ebong bhashar somporke moulik proshner byabosthit adhyan. Eta soygyaner bauddhik bhitti hishebe kaj kore jekhan theke biggan, nastikota, rajnoitik adorsho, ebong byaktigoto drishtibhongi amader bastobota byakha korte udbhot hoy

Khulun
B

Belief

Ekta upodesh, kothaboli, ba dharona ke shotti mone korar manoshik obostha, anubhobik tothyo nirbishishe. Eta byobosthit shottyo ebong norom obokaloner upor bhitti kore, kothin tothyer poriborte, jake ain, adorsho, ebong dhormer jonno moulik kore tole

Khulun
B

Bangladesh

Bangal Upashagorer opor ekti shorvboum desh ebong prachin Vanga o Gaudar uttoradhikari; eta ekti ardho-dhormanirapeksha projatontro jekhane Islam rajdharmer marya pabe, Animism, Hindu, o Bouddho dhorme ghotito, Mughal shongshkarer por Muslim-sangkhayok hoye utheche

Khulun
I

Islam

Ekti ekeshwarobadi Abrahamic dhormo Quran er upor bhitti kore, jake anusarira ekti devatar mukher kotha mone kore, ebong Muhammad (Hadith) er shikkhar upor. Eta ekta sampurna jibondrishti, ain byabostha, ebong bhokti o byobosthit shottyer upor ghotito adorsho hishebe kaj kore, kothin anubhobik obokaloner poriborte

Khulun
L

Jibondrishti

Bisshash, drirho bisshash, ebong mull-er ekta sampurna kathamo yar madhyame ekjon byakti ba sanskriti biswake byakhya kore ebong bastobota sathe mithok rakhe. Eta dorshon, adorsho, ba dhormoke ekta byaktigoto kothaboyeye songhoto kore je uddeshya, niti, ebong kormo nirdeshito kore

Khulun

ftid.title: Itihas ┃ Vanga Vitanastika
ftid.lead: Eti ki ebong ete kebhabe dekha hoy?
ftid.body:
Mul Kotha:

Atit Baki Fela, Shokti, Sthitoman, ebong Byabash

Itihas amader kache khanda khanda roop-e eshe pohanchche. Eta purno abritti hishebe ashe na, karon eta procholito hoyeche tader haate jara kono itihaskokh er archive khulunor aagei cholito hoyechilo. Manusher beshir bhag onubhob turonto noshto hoye jay. Ekjon maa jokhon jironnok chheleke shanto kore, ekjon sromik nijer mon kore bishoy goshe kore, ekjon byaboshayi ekta doshoktito bepar age theke thamay — ei mongol guli tar manusher jonno ghumonjo purito chilo, kintu keur kache kono chap chhilo na. Tader noshto howa kono byatikrom na. Eta to sadek onubhober sadharon nosti.

Jokhon kichhu lekha hoy, ta lekha hoy ekta udheshyer jonno. Tooriya kora sob somoy protishthaner jonno kore hoy, poro projoner jonno na. Ekjon Babylonilikhok joutro lekhey rekhechilo karon mandirer proshashon tar upor depend korechilo. Kintu tar lekha nei se khaddoshothi je karon-e sekhongkhya shokkho hoyechilo. Ekjon Tang rajyoder itihaslekho rajya dorbodon ke songe korechilo karon setar kaj chhilo. Kintu tar lekha nei proshashon griher bahire je hoyto-hattya kora hoyechilo. Archive shuru hoy byabachanar saath, ebong sei byabachana dharabahik mulyer swargolok ke pradhershon kore. Michel Rolph Trouillot etake kothashopto bolechen jokhon bolechen je itihaser noshto toiri hoy shrishtir shomoye, hote pare noshto-hoar shomoye na.

Jokhon ekta tooriya ache, ta nibedon er dutiyo chorjhae pravesh kore. Bancha thaka bhabe boro guruttopurno na. Ekta matir tablet bancha thaklo karon eta byabohar kore shokto kore diyechilo jate nami dhorte pare. Ekta pustok bancha thaklo karon bhikhu guli shatabdi dhore etar copy korechilo. Ar pustok noshto hoye gelo karon poka okti kheyechilo ba karon ekjon lipikar shosser mato kore parchment abar byabohar korte chepechilo. Agun, nog, juddho, abekkhya — eta durlopo bishorjon na. Eta to archive jekhane bancha ba noshto hoy tar sadharon obostha.

Soroter madhyom-e je bancha thake ta roopantorito hoy. Lipikara bhul kore pod-pod ta porle. Anuvadak kore byabashayin byabachana. Tottho alope bhasha prachor hoye tokhon dhore thake. Grik shobdoti Latin verbum hoye jay, ebong ekta darsik niti ekta byakkhik ekok e komiye jay. Tokhon jokhon pustok e sob bhorti podokkhiptider kache pohanchche, tar aagei koyekti porjar roopantor hote hoyeche.

Folita holo je ekti tooriya bhabhe dekhle beshi purno, kintu na. Manusher guli protichchobito kore prachin Grikder ki bisshas korechilo, joto-tuku Grik sahityo er ektushthangsho bancha thakar kotha. Sophocles lekhechilo eksho theke beshi natok. Amader sat ache. Bancha thaka grontha-byabaha darshay Byazantiner shodhokder copy kora abhyash, Islamik intelektual kendarer chokkhu, ebong Renesan serchhoder pochondo. Eta Grik chintabidder sampoorno range ke protyobimbon kore na. Bancha thakar bias poton hoye jay thik tai jeno eta somborno.

Itihashguli kaj kore ei abhaver dharar niche. Tara khande khande theke byabostha toiri kore ebong tai lalchabenna je khande guli pratinidhitwa kore. Archive ekti shafol drishti na. Seti nijei ekti shoktir, sujoger, ebong soroter toiri byabohar. Protiti bancha thaka strot eiti dukkho ache, je kotha ta bolche ebong je kotha ta keno bancha thaklo.

Byabash addar onno ekti porjar dharai. Kono itihashlok atiter kache ashe na aghatito dhara chara. Otor dinider jagone bisshas kora byabostha manusher swatantrikota, monoshobishleshon, bigganer tottho, ebong odhikarer bhasha diye toiri hoyeche. Aguner dinider manusher guli bhinno dritter byabosthay banchit. Honor, divya shokti, shakun aadharonito tottho, humoral chikitsa — eta sob aguner adhunik goner protitip na chilo. Eta chilo sogo dritter byabostha je gulo dinidin jibon ke ghire rekhechilo.

Duti byabokriti ei feleg dura korte shohay kore. Byaboktitik juktidharan aguner dinider ke oborodh kore adhunik manak diye. Eta prakrito birodh o obocchhed guli pradhansho kore, kintu itihasoktomder ke noitik chitrokoroshito mone kore fele. Itihaser shahanubhuti cheshta kore purbonirmito chintadhara ke tader nijer bhashay bujhte. Eta prashna kore sei shomoye ki kotha toettho chilo, sei shomoyer simaboddhoita ebong bishwashonmoy byabosthar modhye. Duti poth-i ekta ghotona byabashayin vabe byakha korte pare, kintu tader folito eki na. Itihaser purono dekhaar jonno duthi dritti ek sathe rakha dorkar.

Yulius Siserer moton tomar guli darshay kivabe byabashayin byabostha itihaser bujhdhar ghire prabhab folay. Siser dekha jay ekjon sanskarok hishebe je ekta noshto hobar prajanotantre sthir kore, ba ekjon lalshi amaler je ekta sotanter byabostha noshto kore. Duti poddosho eki prodhan pramaner upor bhitti kore. Tara mile na karon tara bhinno bhoy ke guruttopurno mone kore, sthanibaddhota ba sottantrata.

Muhammad akjon aro kothin byabashayin bibhed ke darshay. Biswashi der kache, tini shes nabi, ebong tar jibon dhormiyon protogolide shoman nyamito nirdeshona dite. Secular itihashlokder kache, tini shat-shotir ekjon neta je karjyoguli Hijaj-er rajnoitik o shomajik obosthar modhye byabashayin bujha jay. Ei bibhed shudhu tothyer na. Eta praman ke mone kore ebong atit ke bortoman upor koto khamota rokhite cheye.

Itihaser gyan shudhu totoborti bhabhe sthir hoy. Eta shob birodh ke ekti nirnoyotomo kothabolite shoman korte pare na karon prodhan praman abritik ebong porjar. Sabche nirdishtho sthan-noi, tahol erokom rokhonno drishti. Atit bojha jay, kintu abritik vabe, ebong kokhono ekta koner dike na. Protiti punarnirman je kichhu bancha thaklo, je kichhu copy kora hoylo, ebong bortoman ki dekhte shokkhom tar upor bhitti kore toiri hoyeche.

Duti ghiroi noishchoyo bhabhe itihaser smritir ekti oddhut sthan rokhon kore. Tader karjyoguli ke koyekjon gaurab mone kore, aranjon noshto kore, ebong byabashayin guli kokhono ekti dishe sthir hoy na. Ekjon shomuoy je ki gaurabjoggo, arekjon bolte hoy khotikarok. Eki karjyokrom ekta noitik byabosthay dhormijoggo, ar arekta byabosthay odbidhokarok. Ei shoshyo palon, almost ekti ghumonjo dhari byabashayiner palon, ekti tooriyar dosh na. Eta itihaser guruttopurno toettho kivabe toiri hoy tar ekta bisheshota.

Muhammad er khettre ei byabokriti aro jatil hoy karon tar rohitsho shudhu atiter modhye simito na. Hajar koti Musulmaner kache, tini aadarsho byabokritir model, ebong tar jibon dhormiyon nyamito kormokolap, noitik tottho, ebong shommilit shokti ke ghire thake. Jikono kaj je shat-shotir arbiarabia-e sadharon chilo ba ghirjoggo, ajke beshir manusher kache kothin ba odbidhokarok mone hoy, kintu biswashi der kache eta ekti pavitro chhobir angshoi royeche. Folita holo birodh je ekta manak diye somadhan kora jay na. Eta soboronto toettho je itihaser tomar guli shudhu tader nijer shomoye banchi na. Tara manusher smriti, ashah, ebong noitik byabosthar modhye banchi.

Ki Ghoteche:

Ekta Sompedit Gobeshona

Jot dure jaoa jay lekha byabashayin toettho miliye jay. Jeta roye thake ta holo boshhok, haddo, oluker mati, ebong jinir porishkare. Byabashayin toettho ache, kintu eta bhashar simaboddhoitai na, porishkar toetthor simaboddhoitai diti.

Prachin hominin guli prothom proshno toiri kore. Australopithecus afarensis, prai 3.2 million bochor age, chinta kore thaklo tara urdho mukho hoye. Chhoto dimag, dirgho hato, ontormujbo bhangir proman. Tara kono shurur toettho nooi, shudhu ekta porjaye ekta lambo pariborton. Prai 2.8 million bochor age, Homo je shrenir prachin sobhok guli dekha jay. Prodhan praman kom, ektar khere, arekta khande, poriborton dekhaar moto, kintu purno jibon abar gorte parbe na. Dimag, khabar, ebong byabokriti sob dhire dhire badhe. 2.4 million bochor age, Homo habilis sadharon Oldowan tooriya bhyer mangsho katte ebong haddo bhenge, pordar porishkar joto shokti, je guli porborti byabokriti ke ghire rekhechilo.

Homo erectus eshe jay prai 1.9 million bochor age, ebong poriborton aro shafol hoye ute. Deher bhangir moto adhunik manusher moto, lambo pa jatra korte bhalo. Agun eshe jay, khabar, poth, surokha, ebong shomajik chokrer bodlol ghote. Tarpor bicheron, Afrika theke baria mahadviper dike, notun jolobayur o notun chap er dike. Neanderthal Europe ebong pashchim eshiar dike uthe ashe, thanday mache boro, boro dimag, tooriya shokkhom, ebong shombhoboto pratik byabokriti. Tara noshto manush na, shudhu manusher poribarer arekta shakha.

Jokhon Homo sapiens prai 60,000 theke 70,000 bochor age Afrika chhere beroy, tara ei sob guli ke dekhe. Dekha-akta bhinno hoy, shanti-moy, boiddho, mishron. Miliye thakar poriborton royeche je ajker Afrika er bahire manusher ghirer modhye, rogh protirodh, choramukher poriborton, ebong sob bojon prakriyar modhye. Prochin shomporko jibon chokrote ache. Chhoto bishoy guli jome uthe. Nil chokh, udaharaner jonno, shuru hoy ekta chhoto pariborton je melanin toiri kore. Ekjon porbapok, ekta poriborton, ebong kal er saath bicheron hoy karon aji porjonto nirdharon kora hoy nai.

Manusher beshir bhag jiboner somoy, tara shikkhok bhabe banchi. Chhoto dol porishkar kore jay, khabar bhinno, ebong kaj obosthiti onujayi poriborton hoy. Shomajik swargolok ache kintu shokto kormo, store, abhabe simito. Adhyatmik byabostha prae prakriti ebong pranir saath juro. Bajrapat, nod, shikarer prani, ebong akashgoler chokra sakriyo shokti hoye uthe, durer abstrakt na. Anusthan prakriti theke uthe, dharmoshashtro theke na. Ondhokari proshno guli uttirn uttor chara uthe. Venus murti guli ekebare prachor, tarka-chara, bhinno byabashayin bhabhe, fertilitir protik, anusthaniya object, ba byaktigoto protinidhitwa hishebe byabashayin kora hoy. Ekta shamotar noi, shudhu sombhabona.

Prai 10,000 BCE, krishti eshe jay. Manusher khaddo utpadon shuru kore, shikar na, ebong lokshongkha bari uthe. Khabar shimito hoy, kaj beshi hoy, ebong abashik guli gramo, shohor, ebong prachin shohor e dhrukkho hoye uthe. Ghanishtho rog, doth, ebong notun bhoy eshe jay. Sheshe, lokshongkha itte kore shikarer pothe ferar sambhabona noshto hoy. Shokto kormo khanij prodhon kore. Koyekjon kormo poriborton kore, tooriya toiri kore, nirdhomon chalon kore, ba anusthaner jibon dekhen. Swargolok aro swachchhobhito hoye uthe.

Dhormo o poriborton hoy. Chhoto porimaner sthanik prakritibondhonito byabosthar bukkhae, boro shamuh guli shuru kore ekta shadharan bishwashonmoy byabostha toiri kore. Mondir eshe jay. Pujari uthe uthe. Anusthan byabosthito hoy, ad hoc na. Bisshas prerito poriborton hoy, prakritik bhuter dike na, motamuti devtar dike je guli fertiliti, jolobayur, juddho, ebong rajotwo shonchalon kore. Dhormo ekjuti, sojotri, ebong smriti er hater uthe. Eta biddesho hono karon pashe pashe bhinno devta ebong biddesho kormadhikar niye jol kore.

Lekhona shuru hoy prai 3200 BCE Sumer-e, prathom hisab-er jonno, shossher poriman gorar jonno, porimer ganonar jonno, sromer kormadhikar gorar jonno. Poriborton poriborton poriborton poriborton poriborton poriborton poriborton. Lekhona thakle, smriti poriborton hoy. Gyan store korte hobe chitir bahire. Kotha sthir hoy. Anusthan byabosthito hoy. Khamota ekta notun modhyom pete.

Birodh o boro hoy. Chhoto birodh royeche, kintu byabosthit juddho sambhabona hoye uthe. Karjyo ekakari, joto kormo, bhoy, biswas, ebong lalsha. Dhormo ekta artho er hater uthe ebong bicheron er justify kore. Birodher ekta matro karan hoy na.

Puri timeline e, ekta porishkar mone hoy. Poriborton er saath poriborton hoye. Ekti dike labh, arer dike khoti. Beshi khaddo, beshi rog. Beshi gathan, beshi swargolok. Beshi gyan, beshi jatil. Ekti dishe nooi, shudhu jome jowa ebong poriborton.

Borbortoman:

Borbortoman Itihas Kivabe Dekha Jaite Pare

Porogamon podokkhipter guli amader ke amader nijer mato dekhbe na. Tader byabashayin guli thakbe je ki bancha thaklo, je ki guruttopurno mone kore, ebong je ki byabostha tader byabostha ke ghire rekheche. Nirnay ghuin ghorar shakha diye na, shudhu tader byabashayin guli ki poriborton kore sheta dekha.

Tara amader khaddo byabostha dekhite pare ebong bole pare je ekta sabhyota je utpadon beshi korechilo porishkritir bokkhon e. Sorkari krishi dekhte pare ondha, karkhana-moto, ba shudhu oboshyo, obhigroher upor bhitti kore poriborton kore kivabe sthir, bhoy, ebong shongskriti guli ke shontulito kore. Lab-e toiri ebong jinite khaddo ke mone korte hobe abritik ba oboshok na. Artho ki tara sheshe khabar ba keno.

Chikitsa o bhinno dekhte pare. Ajke jake jibon dawaboli mone hoy — kemotherapi, brihottom chikitsa, boro orodhok boshodh — eta dekhte pare khokro jodi porogamon chikitsa aro nirdishtho hoy. Ba eta ke protishito kora jete pare, shilpo-kal theke eka karon eka shilpo-kal er modhye kaj korechilo. Progresh noshto noi, ebong porogamon kormo-sampotti amader prokhordh guli ke resourceful mone korte pare, khokro na.

Jolobayur ebong urja shombhoboto foler drishti diye porishkare hobe. Jodi obostha khoti bari, amader jukti nidoshkorto ba kormo-khorcho hote pare. Jodi porogamon byabostha tader jolobayur sthir kore, tara amader jotiltoir er upor depend kora dekhite pare jeta oborodhito prograsher ebong simito bikalper porishkar toiri hoyeche. Nabojurjyo abriti hote pare. Ajker beshir "porishkar" byabostha joldroto gas reactor grid sthir korte use kore, mane tara jolito kol theke shudhu ektu porishkar. Porogamon itihashlok eta abriti na mone korte pare, ekti aprapto porishkar je jotiltoir theke berote pare ni.

Arthobabostha o poriborton artho hote pare. Dhormijoggo dhormijoggo dhormijoggo dhormijoggo. Porogamon observer guli poriborton korte pare, ba tara amader jukti ke ager kal theke mone kore ebong unnotti dekhite pare. Tader guruttopurno byabostha ei kotha toiri korbe.

Noitik byabostha o poriborton hoy. Porogamon shomaj guli obak hote pare amra kichhu khettre koto khulano ebong kichhu khettre koto sthir. Tara amader prokashe uttejonamulok ba odhikari mone korte pare, amader sangskritik simaboddho, protishthan, ebong biswas byabostha ke ati sthir mone kore. Ajke je shadharon mone hoy, pore bikolpo hote pare, ekta mishron je prokasito swatantrata ebong shokto sima nirdharon kore na.

Dhormo koyekti dike porishkare hobe. Jodi eta komi, ei jukti shesher ekta boro prokriti hote pare. Jodi eta thake ba poriborton hoy, amader goner guli dekhte pare gramin ba jekhane ar kotha guruttopurno na. Ajke je guruttopurno mone hoy, pore noshto hote pare, ebong je noshto mone hoy pore mul dharabahika hoye uthte pare. Dhormiyo artho bancha thake, kintu kokhono poriborton chara bancha thake na.

Tooriya ebong smriti sobcheye kothin noshoitir shomukhe. Porogamon itihashlok inherite korbe boro archive jeta surakkhito tothyo, je beshi poriborton korte parbe byaktigoto jibon atuloniyo tathar saath. Ba tara bujhte parbe noshto file, bhonge form, noshto store, ebong byabachito bancha thaka. Sombhobona ache tara amader kache beshi gyan paben ager kono jukti theke. Ebong sombhobona ache tara kom gyan paben, amader jukti punarnirman korte hobe shorirer baki theke karon digital porjar bancha thaka nei.

Jekono ta hok, tader porishkare eki hobe na. Tara inherite korbe amader byabachana diye toiri ekta byabostha, kintu tara sei byabachana guli nijer simaboddho diye porishkare korbe. Tara amader drishtibhongi ebong tader drishtibhongi er modhye jete hobe tar modhye notun artho, notun noshto, ebong notun proshno guli hobe je amra ghoshito korte parbo na. Itihas chalito thakbe tar porishkare, jome jowa ebong poriborton, je ki bancha thaklo ebong porogamon chittodder ki dekhar protoyojy.

vanga.title: Vanga ┃ Vanga Vitanastika
vanga.lead: Prachin polimotir bhitti theke adhunik deltar kathamokkhon bostobota porjonto ekti bistarito aitihashik kathamo.
vanga.body:
Angsho I:

Delta-r Mandalas

1. Vanga-er Age: Maati ebong Pathor

Raja-guli jokhon pathor-e naam korar aage-i, bhoomi chhilo nodir ekti ghumer modhho. Ghonno mangroho jolombor-er shoril diye dhaka chhilo delta-ta. Lal-maater pahar-er dharaguli bhoomike ghire rekhechilo. Mrijon-nirjaton kora manush-guli Stone Age-er lal-maater Barind ebong Madhupur formations-er dike hete cholen Pandu Rajar Dhibi, Ajay Valley, ebong Bharatpur-e kora prothomanushik khujjay ekta sthir Chalcolithic shongskritir proman pai. Eta 2000 BCE-sh jonno. Ei prachin manush-guli ekaki chilen na. Tara boro prothomanushik probash-i angsho chilen.

Austroasiatic probash-er fole Santhal ebong Munda-der purbopuron bhromon shuru hoy Madhya India ebong pashchim pahar-er diye. Tara noyonchosh-er chash, bishesh kore aman ebong aus, nimoncho-er dike ane. Tara prathmik sinchai prokriya toiri korechilo. Tara borsha-musum-er noitijjy abhabe pracholito delta-r maati ke shanto korechilo. Porbe, Tibeto-Burman goshtiguli Himalayan paharer foothills ebong purbo pahar theke neme ashe. Eta sondhi-mahadesh-er uttor ebong purbo shima-r dike ekti jotil adharit ebong bhashar jal toiri kore.

Ei goshti-guli kaj korechilo kendriyo rajjyo gathon chara. Tara kendriyo rajjyo byabostha chilen na. Tara sthaniyo tooriya-er upor depend korechilo, microliths ebong polis kora pathor-er katha byabohar kore ghonno, ushnokaliner jolombor-er maater angsho porishkar korechilo. Durbal, machhar-er jolombor bhoomi ke porishkar kore prodhhan krishi-er jayga toiri korechilo onek porishromi, Indo-Aryan bhasha ba uttor-er rajnoitik dharabali ashar aagei. Ei shanto kaal-er fole gombhir krishi-er bhitti, bhashar mul, ebong jol-er shathe porishkaritir ekta bhab-ta toiri hoyeche. Je delta-er rajjyo-der shuru hote chilo setar bhitti tai toiri kore.

2. Vanga: Samudrik Hathi Rajjyo

Prachin rajnoitik entiti Vanga udhimitro ekta khamota kendro hishebe uthe ashe purbodik-er deltar dike. Eta bhorti chilo poschim Banglar poschim-dik ebong dakshin Bangladesh-er ongsho diye. Prachin Sanskrit sahityo, jemon Aitareya Aranyaka, Vanga ke prothom uddessho kore ekta spasht bhashar shathe. Setin guli bhinno, bairiddhipto poradeshi manush hishebe dekhechilo, Vedic duniya theke alhada, manush-ke pokkhir upor bhasha diye. Kintu Mahabharata ebong Ramayana-er moto mahakabbe Vanga-ke ar kono jungli shima hishebe bhafoa jay ni. Eta boro jonoshonkhyay hatti, mahashagro jahaj, ebong shomriddho byaboshayir shomuho diye paribortito hoye ekta sainik rajjyo hoye uthechilo.

Grik ebong Roman itihashlok, jemon Megasthenes, Ptolemy, ebong Diodorus Siculus, Gangaridai namak ekta shoktishali rajjyo niye lekhechilo. Adhunik itihashlok eta protischit Vanga-ke shongyojito kore. Pashchimi shahajjo kotha bolte Gangaridai-r sainik byabostha Alexander the Great-ke bhoy diyeche. Balo hashti, atibahini, ebong shromik sreni diye bhorti. Ei bhoyer fole Beas nodir par 326 BCE te tader bikkhov hoy, ebong purbo dike abhijit yuddho bondho hoye jay.

Vanga tar oguner shomriddhi ebong rajnoitik khamota purno vabe tar bhougolik obosthaner upor depend korechilo. Rajjyo-ta chhilo sobcheye busy sarbakshin banijjer poth-er upor. Ei poth-guli Gangaridai ebong Brahmaputra-r bhitorko nodiral jale sarbakshin Bangh-er sathe jog korechilo. Vanga-r byaboshayi-guli toiri korechilo shokto, mahashagro jahaj. Ei jahaj-guli niyomito banijjer pothe Sri Lanka ebong dakshin purbo Asia-dike, jeta tahole Suvarnabhumi namkhoito chilo. Tara Roman duniyar sathe porapora jol-jatra rokhechilo. Tara porishkar muslin kapod, moti, kachhobish, ebong byatikto kathar shathe sona, rodi, ebong Roman mritshilpo banijjer kormo korechilo. Wari-Bateshwar-er moto prothomanushik kendro dekha jay ekti uchchakhorir shomaj, je khete plan kora poth, prachir, loha-gorjon karkhana, mudra, ebong antorjatik banijjer shomporko chhilo. Ei sob bole Vanga ke jungli delta theke prachin duniyar ekta shomriddho kendro te rupoantor kore.

3. Tara-r Shossho: Delta-r Mandala

Prachin Bangla kokhono ekok, shobdojukto rajjyo chilo na. Er boddhe eta alhada-chalito, pratisphurdha sub-region sreni hishebe kaj korechilo, jader nam Mandalas. Pratiti ekta sthaniyo porichoy, bhinno bhougolik obosthan, arthik bhitti, ebong shasan kormo chakri chhilo. Vanga delta-te boro kache rajjyo-der sathe porapora kore, noshto hoye jaowa shima, prachur banijjer porishphurdha, ebong suddenly sainik mitrata chakkar chalito.

Pundravardhana: Utter dike Pundravardhana, bhorti adarshokrantor North Bengal ebong Rajshahi Division-er bhougolik obosthan-er dike. Karatoya nodir par Mahasthangarh-er boro prachir diye shohor Pundravardhana ei shohor-er prochurto itihas er modhye Maurya kal theke uttoradhikar dhormiyo itihas-er sathe uthe ashe.

Samatata ebong Harikela: Purbo dike, boro ebong pracholito Meghna nodir par, Samatata ebong Harikela, jekhane Comilla, Noakhali, Chittagong, ebong Sylhet obosthito. Samatata chhilo ekti jolombor rajjyo, je dino porjonto boro rajjyo-guli uttor dike shasan korechilo tokhon-o Buddhist prashashon porichoy-ta rokhe rekhechilo. Tar rajdhoni Devaparvata chhilo gyan ebong sarbakshin banijjer ekta boro kendro.

Radha: Pashchim dike, Bihar ebong Jharkhand-er shima-er upor, Radha, jeta paramparik vabe uttor ebong dakshin angsho-bhagito chhilo. Radha-r manush-guli prachin Jain text-guli jemon Acaranga Sutra-er modhye swatantrik, jungli, ebong bahiragoto poribromonkarider prati agroho-hin hishebe bibhushito, projatri sannyasi-der upor kukur chhere dite.

Gauda: Madhya Bangla Gauda-er sathe chhilo, Gangaridai-r prধান nodir par, je Shashanka-er rajnoitik utshoho noishchoy kore shatom shatabdir shurute. Shashanka prothom swadhin, shobdojukto Bangali rajjyo toiri kore, Uttar Bharat-er pradhon rajjyo-ke sidhdhanto kore.

Anga ebong Kalinga: Aro pashchim ebong dakshin dike Anga (adhunik Bihar-er modhye) ebong Kalinga (adhunik Odisha-er modhye), boro bahiragoto rajjyo, je guli dhorte prachur delta-r bandor-guli. Ei bhirbhiranno padosh-er fole Vanga-ke abosshoi onurodh korte hoy, Bangali sangskriti ekta sobdojukto khondro na, regional paramparar ekta dhoni mishran toiri kore.

Angsho II:

Bhairiddhipto Shima

4. Dhormo: Bhairiddhipto Shima

Delta-tar adhunik dhormiyo itihas-e aste aste astir dhormo er shomuho eshe porinoto hoyeche sthaniyo parampara-take gorjon kore. Seta poroborti bela-er dhormiyo gyan-take samajik bhougol-ta porinoto kore, porber dinidin ajkeo byabahar kora dhormiyo bhitti-guli purno vabe muche fele na. Itihaser obosthate, Bangla shobchoi Uttar Bharat-er orthodox kendrer theke alhada chhilo. Shatabdi dhore, Aryavarta-er boro Brahmin guli delta-take adhunik biruddhi, biddhakari bairer shima hishebe dekhechilo, jekhane bhairiddhipto andolan-guli thrive kore ebong paramparik jaat bhedbhav guli protishthito hoy. Bangla-te pravesh eto dhormiyo dushjonkari mone hoyechilo je uttor-er uttor-Brahmin guli porishkar kormo kore uttor pherote.

Ei bhougolik ebong sangskritik poradhibostha ei shohor-take ekti sakriyo adhunik dhormiyo porichkhyan-er kshetre porinoto kore. Boro sanghojukto bishsho dhormo guli Bangla-ke shohoj, upor theke nicher shasan diye abhibhuito kore nai. Er boddhe, tara ekti bhinno, bhinno, jol-nirbhor shomaj-er obosthar shathe onurodh kore. Buddhism, Jainism, Hinduism, Islam, ebong deshojato lokachar guli alhada kore ekta shafol riti te porinoto hoye na. Tara derdin anek bela alhada jaygai sthit thaklo. Tara prai ek-i pujo-ghor, chitrokala, murti-tattva, ebong sthaniyo pir guli bhorite.

Banglar raja-guli prai dharmaniti-r kshetre kousholiyo bahubandhuki bhababe artoniti chalito. Buddhist Pala raja-guli prai Brahmin mandir-guli artoniti diye ebong Hindu mantri-guli niyog kore. Porbe Hindu shashok guli Buddhist prashthan-guli bhoomi din, ekti bhinno jolombor shomaj-er shomajik shanti rokhar jonno. Ei dhormiyo mishritir itihas dhormiye ekti fluid, byaktigoto, ebong guhya anubhob roop dite, rigid protishthaner kothar na. Eta bhinno regional monobritti toiri kore je jekhane emotion bhokti, darsik alochana, ebong guhya kormokolap-er chay kormo-r theke beshi mullo pabe.

5. Animism: Deshojato Bhitti

Protishthaner mandir, lekha granth, ba shobhojo pojari guli jokhon-o ashar aage, Banglar deshojato manush-guli pratichino Animism, Totemism, ebong prakriti-puja kore thakto. Tara prakritik duniya ke ekti sakriyo, jolombor network mone kore je jekhane shoktishali bhuter shomuho, sthaniyo devata, ebong purbopuron shokti ache. Ei shokti-guli nirantor somman, kotha-barta, ebong bishesh kormo-r dorkar rakhe. Karon delta-tar obostha chhilo onek volatile, suddenly barsha, nodir poth bodle jawa, ebong bhoyonkor predetor-er sathe, prachin Animism prai survival, prakritir somman, ebong paribesh-er shomite kendra-bindu chilo.

Ei prachin bishwas guli kokhono purno vabe noshto hoyni. Er boddhe, tara Bangali lok shongskritir bhitti hoye alhada dhormiyo prabeshi dhormiye modhye porishkarit hoy.

Manasa: Nagini Manasa-er puja shuru hoyeche machhar jal-matir bhougol theke, jekhane bisil kobra-er bhoy chhilo. Seta lok-kihini-r kendriyo byakkha hoye, prakritir obostha-ke bojhay je jibon dite pare ba nite pare.

Bonbibi ebong Dakshin Rai: Sundarban-er boro jolombor-er jungli bhoomi-te, dhormiyo sima purno vabe nisshobdo hoye jay. Aj-o, Hindu moshai ebong Muslim modhu sanchayokar guli Bonbibi-r, orthe bon er dokhino, ebong tar birodhi Dakshin Rai-r, orthe bagh devtar, sathe sathe pujo kore jangol-e pravesh korar aage, dhormiyo sima muche fele.

Dharma Thakur ebong Pawitra Ban: Erakom-i Dharma Thakur-er puja, orthe fertiliti, surjo, ebong bhoomi-r sathe jog, ebong indigenous tribal goshti-guli Jaher Than-er moto pawitra ban-er nirantor sonrakkhon, bhoomi-r sathe ekta durbin prakritik dhormiyo shomporko dekhay.

Ei Animism byabostha-guli kono porishkalik pojari ba boro pathor-er mandir-er upor depend kore nai. Tara kothar parampara, sthaniyo lokgeet, ebong samajik kormo-er madhyom-e tribal shaman-er hat diye cholto. Ei prachin monobritti Bangali-ke sidhdhanto kore je devta sidhdhanto bhoomi-er modhye ache. Eta paribeshik dhormiyo bhitti toiri kore je aj-o gramin jibon ke prabhavit kore.

6. Protishthan Dhormo: Khamotar Doler Dol

Sanghojukto, protishthito Indian dhormo-guli ashar fole delta-tar rajnoitik, arthik, ebong samajik gothona purno vabe porinoto hoyeche. Eta boro shilpo-er shirjokar era toiri kore, porbe kothin samajik rupoantor-er sathe.

Jainism prothom thekei Pashchim Bangla-te ekta shoktishali pravesh toiri kore. Prachin legend guli bole Mahavira nijei Radha-er jungli poth dhorechen. Sthaniyo manush-guli kar kothin byabahar shahosh kore, sannyas-er darsota bicharan korechilo je prai hajar bochor dhore thrive kore, Pashchim Bangla-jure shokkho Jain upokoron ebong votive murti-er proman diye.

Buddhism ekta boro, anek shatabdir shonakalin yuge pravesh kore Pala Empire-er haturi te, ath shatabdi theke baro shatabdi porjonto. Pala raja-guli boro, rajjyo-proshashonit vihara-guli toiri kore jemon Somapura Mahavihara Naogaon-er modhye ebong Vikramashila Bihar-er modhye. Ei prashthan-guli shudhu dhormiyo gyan dey na. Tara bishshor intelektual kendro chilo, Purbo ebong Dakshin Purbo Asya theke chhatro, tirthayatri, ebong pandit-guli aste. Tara boro tantrik Buddhist darsota, Vajrayana ebong Sahajayana, ebong Atisha Dipamkara-er moto mahapandit-guli toiri kore je sidhdhanto Tibet-e gie Tibetan Buddhism porishkar koren.

Ei Buddhist pradhoniyo bhoomi ekta sudden, pratishthaner dike poriborton hoye jay Baro shatabdite Sena Dynasty-r uthe asar sathe. Sena shashok, je guli Dakshin Bharater Deccan theke eshechilo, Puranik Hinduism-er ekta rigid, orthodox ponrashonilo dharmiyo abhijog korlo. Tara Bangali shomaj-take byabosthito kore kothin jaat byabostha enforce kore. Tara Kulinism shuru kore, je system uccho Brahmin ebong Kayastha gotri-ke bishesh rajnoitik, arthik, ebong biye adhikar dey, indigenous manush-guli ke shima-baddho kore.

Ei sudden, upor theke nicher poriborton onkho shrenir manush ebong baki Buddhist shomuho ke alienate kore. Eta delta-jure kothin samajik poriborton toiri kore. Kintu, kothin rajjyo-shoyito Hinduism-er modhyeo, Bangla ekti bhinno dhormiyo abhijuger uthe ashe jemon Tantrik Shakta parampara, Kali ebong Durga-er puja, ebong porbe Gaudiya Vaishnavism, ruling elite-r kormo-r theke Krishna-er upor bhokti-r chay.

Angsho III:

Krishi ebong Constitution-er Obostha

7. Islam: Krishi ebong Sangskritik Poriborton

Islam-er pravesh purono vabe Banglar manobor, sangskritik, ebong rajnoitik poth-take porinoto kore. 1204 sale, Turkic senapoti Bakhtiyar Khalji ekta choto sreni sainik niye suddenly abhibhujito akromon kore. Se oboshisto Sena Raja Lakshmana Sena-ke Nabadwip-er rajdhoni-te puro chokh-er samne dhorte pare, Muslim shashan-er din shuru kore. Poroborti choddo shatabdi-te shodhho Bengal Sultanate-er maddhome Delhi court-er sathe somporko shoriye diye, ekta shomriddho, sthaniyo Islamic rajjyo toiri hoy. Sultans Bangali bhashar dhormiyo abhijog kore, Sanskrit mahakabba anubad kore, ebong sthaniyo Hindu elite-guli rajjyo byabostha-r sathe jure, bhashamulluk sangskritik shonakalin yug toiri kore.

Kintu, Islam-er porishchor puro Bangla-jure pradhon vabe ekta derdin krishi poriborton, sudden sainik abhijit na. Gangaridai nodir byabostha anek shatabdi dhore purovab-diye porinoto hoye, Bangladesh-er obosthito ghumonjo, ghoono jolombor ebong mangroho jolombor-er porishkar kholti-er dike. Shahjalal Sylhet-er moto karizmatic Sufi pir-guli, ebong Khan Jahan Ali Bagerhat-er moto, sidhdhanto rajjyo bhoomi-dayo-er sathe direct jungli shima-e pore cholen.

Tara ghumonjo kete fele. Tara boro prachir mosjid toiri kore je samajik prashashon kendro hishebe kaj kore. Tara noyonchosh krishi grameen goshti establish kore. Kothin jaat byabostha sahajjo kore, protibaddho onnadhikar krishak ebong sthaniyo deshojato bhokti-mongolite, Sufi-der soman-mulluk byabostha ekta bhodro poth dey.

Sufi-guli sthaniyo sangskritiker sathe kono bhayonkor bibhed dorkar kore nai. Er boddhe, tara jotil Islamic darsota sthaniyo Bangali lok bhasha ebong sangeet-er sathe anubad kore. Eta ekti bhinno, mishrito Islamic monobritti toiri kore je jekhane Islamic byakkha-guli sthaniyo monobritti theke bujha hoy. Ei boro, anek-shatabdir dhormiyo ebong paribeshik poriborton er fole purbo delta-tar dike ekti boro shomuhik Muslim jolombor toiri hoy.

8. Baki Dhormo-er Patan: Maha Manobor Rupoantor

Ei puro dhormiyo poriborton, rajnoitik khamotar derdin poriborton ebong adhunik rajnoitik bhoy-er sathe milke, purbo delta-jure dhormiyo bhougol-ta alhada kore. Anek prachin dhormiyo shomuho noshto hoye gelo ba purno vabe noshto hoye gelo. Sultanate ebong Mughal era-er sathe, Islamic prashthan-guli-ke poth diye, Buddhist vihara-guli purno vabe muche gelo. Monastery-guli je hajar hajar bhikkhu rakto chhilo tara noshto hoye gelo, tader arthik lifeline shoriye gelo, tader bhoomi krishi-er jonno abritto hoye gelo, ebong tader intelektual elite Nepal, Tibet, ebong Dakshin Purbo Asya-dike palie gelo.

Hindu manobor, je ek somoy puro delta-tar dike boro samajik weight chhilo, steady patan-er dike gelo. Shatabdi dhore protishthanik chap, samajik dhormo poriborton, ebong boro itihasik bipod-er fole ei shomuho kome geche. Rajnoitik rupoantor, bishesh kore 1947 sale British India-r bibhajon, Bangla-projone dhormiyo shima diye bhag kore. Ei rajnoitik birodh, porbe Pakistan era-r systematic opresshoner sathe, boro, anek porjayer probash shuru kore. Lakh-khokhok amuslim poribar puro bangla chere egiye West Bengal ebong Bharater onnanno dike gechilo.

Anek purbo zilla-e, prachin parampara ebong utsob manushder smriti theke noshto hoye gelo. Ei systemik manobor rupoantor indigenous manobor ke ekta prai ekak shomuh-e bindu kore. Bibhinno sub-region ebong adhunik purbo delta-jure, ei dhormiyo minority-der patan er fole adhunik Bangla bhashi manusher modhye 97 theke 98 shatangsho Islamic manobor songkha royeche. Eta samajik, nirbachoni, ebong dinidin obostha-ta purno vabe porinoto kore.

9. Constitution-er Bhranti: Naam Matro Somprodaiyota

Bangla-er poriborton er ekti poraekti kotha ache. Mongol-rationalism, poribartanbad, ebong nostikota purono dino theke dhormiyo prodhanoto-ke challenge kore. Ei intelektual jol-er shuru hocche Carvaka ba Lokayata darsotar shathe. Ei poribartanbad poribartan bad darsata Vedic prodhanoto purno vabe pratyakhare kore. Seta poroborti jibon ba atma-er astitwa noshto kore. Seta dhormiyo kormokolap ke pojari shrenir fokir kotha hishebe chinnit kore. Carvaka darsok-guli bole sidhdhanto protyokkhik gyan-er ekmatro sroto, South Asia-r kendro te empirical chintar bhitti toiri kore.

Ei rationalist jwala ekti lokkhi jonaki hoye jolhe 19 shatabdi-r Bangla-abhijan-er somoy. Hindu College-er jubok intelektual, Anglo-Indian kobi Henry Louis Vivian Derozio-r poribartanbad netritwer sathe, jwali Young Bengal andolan toiri kore. Tara orthodox Hindu nisedh ke sidhdhanto kore, muktichinta grohon kore, ebong sob dhormiyo doktrin ke manushhater rationality-r thanda alo-e dhorte. Vidya-sagar-er moto shikkhar stombh-guli poribortonbad-er saath shashon kore, oborodon-biye-ebong mohila shikkhar jonno lrobe, porbe darsota-r dike nostik bhababosti rokhe. 20 shatabdi te, ei rationalist goti poribortonbad birodhi rajnitik andolan ebong somprodaiyoto rajniti toiri kore je 1971 saler mukti juddhe sidhdhanto kore.

1971 sale Bangladesh-er mul constitution toiri korar somoy, somprotidin sompodaiyotake tin-ti mul bhitti hishebe sthir kore. Kintu eta chhilo naame somprodaiyoto. Eta Pakistan-er byaboharik dhormiyo rajniti-r prati ekta rajnoitik pratikriya chhilo, nostikotar gahan darsotar na. 1988 sale Ershad srenir sashon eighth amendment enforce kore je Constitution-er 2A dharay Islam ke rajjyer dhormo ghoshna kore. Dekhao shatabdi porbe, sashon elite-guli ekti bibhbor, birodhi-mulok gyanik gantha toiri kore. 2011 saler 15t Amendment sompodaiyotake ponrabar mukh sorothe anle kintu Islam ke rajjyer dhormo hishebe rokhe dilo.

Aji-o, Islam rajjyer dhormo. Rajjyo kokhono dhormiyo chara mukti dilo na. Nostikota prochar korar ba dhormiyo gothona bhongar kono rajjyo proshashon chilo na. Dhormiyo sreni theke alhada kora chara, constitution somprodaiyoto toiri kore je sob dhormiyo byabosthake soman odhikar dey rajnoitik obostha-r dike. Niyog, borgo, ebong poribarer byabostha sthir dhormiyo ain-er sathe bonded. Rajjyo kokhono ekta soman, somprodaiyoto civil code toiri kore nai. Ei byabostha-guli sthir rakhe, proshashon noishchoy kore je byakti kokhono gyanik bhabe dhormiyo shreni theke mukti pete pare na. Dhormiyo jabol theke bhodro mukti chilo na.

10. Rationalism ebong Birodh-er Systemic Shoshon

Karon rajjyo kokhono dhormiyo chara bhodro mukti sthir korte parini, sakriyo rationalism ebong bigganer shongshoyer jayga murore geche. 1971 saler juddho nijei ekta boro ideolozhik birodh chhilo. Bharat, ekta somprodaiyoto rajyo je Hindu somuho dhorte, ebong Soviet sangh, ekta nostik Marxist-Leninist rajyo, Bangali rajniti-r sathe mitrata kore Pakistan-ke parajito kore. Pakistan Islamic idiolozhi byabohar kore ekta bhoyonkor sainik abhibhujito kormoshonali justify kore. Ei bipoder somoy, bishwor Islamic duniya ebong OIC prai noshto thaklo. Tara Pakistan-er bhougolik odhikar ke lokkho Musulman-er pran-er theke beshi guruttopurno mone kore.

Porajoyer por, Pakistan poroborti 1971 saler kothin sompodaiyotar dike giyeche. General Zia-ul-Haq-er shashon-e Islam-er poribartanbad doktrin sthiro hoy Saudi Arabia-r madrasa pipeline-er sahajjo te. Aj, Pakistan arthoniti-r upor depend royeche, China-r porishkha jekhane 65 billion dollar CPEC project chole, rajjyo noshto hote debar theke. Er biruddhe, Bangladesh global garment banijjer dike nijer arthoniti engine toiri kore, sikkha ebong mohila shromi obhijukti-er boro unnoyon toiri kore.

Kintu, tar systemik ebong rajnoitik obostha gombhir birodhito royeche. Bharat, ekta bahurangi rajjo toiri korte arthoniti bhitti acheo, rajnoitik shreni prai dhormiyo abhigrahan ke shock absorber hishebe byabohar kore. Nosto lok-kobitwa ba blog-guli dhormiyo doktrin ke bigganer tolosho-er modhye dhorte khushi noy, rajnoitik elite conservative gonder saath chup thakto beshi pasand kore. Kothin ain dhormiyo abhigrahan jolano doshor kore. Rajjyo effectively orthodoxy-r enforcement wing hishebe kaj kore. Ei obostha ekta shromik-goshthi toiri kore je prai proyogik innovation-er dharadhari chokh-r abhabe, Singapur theke porishkar indhan abar arosonno-er moton logistik birodhite stuck.

11. Soman-odhikar-er Bhranti ba Kalponik Chara Swatantrata

Adhunik rationalist-guli bole poth-ta somprodaiyoto chara ekta revolution chara: shudhu somprodaiyoto chara na, ekta Constitution-er dike "Freedom from Fantasy"-er dike. Kintu kono pradhonik alochana ei definition bodlar korte nai. Kono sakriyo rajnoitik abhijog nai je kalponikke soman odhikar dey. Paramparik somprodaiyoto dhormiyo kalponik ke desher sangskritik ebong monoshik bhougol-ke sashon korte dey. 97 theke 98 shatangsho somuho pradhonik jolombor obosthite, eta purno majoritarian pradhoni-er dike noshto hoy.

Islam ke rajjyer dhormo hishebe sthir kore somprodaiyotar token upor sahajjo kora purno vabe khela-ta prakasherito kore. Eta bojhay je constitutional gothona pratisphurdha dhormiyo byabosthar majhe rajnoitik shanti-chodhana khojje, nostikotar na. Shotti "Freedom from Fantasy" byabostha chai je jekhane rajnoitik siddhanton bigganer porikkha-r maan pabe, dhormiyo doktrin purno vabe muche fele. Eta toiri korte shikkha khetrer purno rupoantor lage, dogmatic dhormiyo shikkha guli logic, empirik biggan, ebong bigganer noiti diye poriborton kore.

Bortoman, rajnoitik shreni ei alochana guli puro vabe avoid kore. Tara somaner chayga-er theke ekta shanto, manoniyo shomaj pasand kore. Jot din porjonto sashon dhormiyo abhigrahan ke somaner dike byabohar kore, desh prai unnoyito hobe na, ekta noshto, lukewarm sthan-e stuck.

bangla.title: Bangla ┃ Vanga Vitanastika
bangla.lead: Bangladesher utthon ebong er adhunik kathamokkhon landscape.
bangla.body:
Angsho I:

1971 Sale Bangladesh er Utthona

1971 sale Bangladesh-er utthona fankha theke uthe ni. Seta ekta obostha-e uthechilo je jekhane porichoy, dritti, ebong rajnoitik bandhota birodhi hoye uthchilo. Bharat, ekta somprodaiyoto rajyo je Hindu somuho dhorte, nijer dike South Asian rajniti-r sob bipodline-ke sporsho korte baddho hoyeche. Soviet Sangh, nostik o Marxist-Leninist doktrin-er sathe, Bharater sobcheye bharosyayon bahirik partner hoye uthe. Pakistan, jekhane dhormiyo, rajnoitik, ba Cold War lens-er dike dekha hoto, bhoj porjonto loyte. Ei bhougolik obosthate Bharat kendriyo byakkha chilo, ichcha theke noy, dorkar theke.

1971 sale Bangladesh-er jonmo nijer proshno theke uthe ni. Biporit porichoy, birodhi dritti, ebong boro rajnoitik jukti-guli ekmushe birodhi hoye uthchilo. Bharat, ekta somprodaiyoto rajyo je Hindu somuho dhorte, suddenly ek bipodline-er dike takate baddho hoyeche je South Asia-r sob rajnoitik bipodline-ke trigger korechilo. Soviet Sangh, nostik o Marxist-Leninist rajjo Bharater sobcheye bharosyayon partner hoye uthe. Arek dike, Pakistan nijer matha nijer haate dhorte cheyechilo, porishkar rajnoitik, dhormiyo, ba Cold War lens-er manush-der sahajjo niye. Bharat ekhane mukhyo byakkha hote chaile ni; dorkar-i tar haate koreche.

Bharat-er modhye, rajniti-guru ebong nagorik guli jore jore jukti kore. Konek manush sothyo dabi kore, Pakistan ebong tar shoktishali bahirik mitro-der sathe boro sainik poriborton-er bhoye. Arekjon guli bole kichhu na kore ekanno nirdosh-er nirdosh-er porishkar korechi ebong sthir, noshtokori sharnarthi-er onushthan korte hobe. New Delhi-r somprodaiyoto netritwo ekta kothin noitik ebong rajnoitik bipod-er dike jay, Hindu, Muslim, Sikh, ebong Christian guli ek shathe banchito.

Tara choto-choto, sothyo paash diye shuru kore. Bharat Mukti Bahin-ke gupto sahajjo dey, sidhdhanto Bengali gerilla-guli sidhdhanto kore ebong shastro diye. Ei kom-intensity campaign Pakistani sainik manoromo-ke aste aste kore fele ebong desher odhikari abhibhujitor bhoy-ke duniya-ke samne prakasherito kore. 1971 saler majhe, New Delhi ekta kothin toettho shikar kore: rajnoitik samadhan kora jay na abhijojito sainik shoshon er sathe.

Tarpor boro rajnokitik poriborton-ta eshe. August-e, Bharat Soviet Sangher sathe Shanti, Mitro, ebong Sahajjo Chukti-er saath signed kore. Sposhto kore dekhi: Moscow ei chukti sangskritik sneher sathe kore nai. Tara eta kore karon Pakistan China ebong Amerika-r sathe kachakachi royeche, Kremliner duto shatru. Ei chukti Bharat-ke shotti rajnokitik gonjil diye, New Delhi-ke chinita chara kaj korte diye, Cheener sainik ba Amerikari jahaj-guli Bangh-er modhye kotha bolte na pare.

Pakistan 3 December-ebong joruri hawa akromon diye puro juddho shuru kore. Bharat turonto sahajjo kore. Sainik byabostha Mukti Bahin-ke Mitro Bahin-er sathe jure, ekta jukto bal toiri kore, bhalo sthaniyo gyan ebong boro nagorik sahajjo-er sathe. Bharater shonir bhalo kaj kore. Tara Pakistani ghumonjo muche fele, jol-jatra line muche fele, ebong Dhaka-r dike dour. Rajdhoni trisho-der modhye pore. Eta shudhu sainik bijoy noy; eta rajnoitik bhougol porichoyer purno rupoantor kore ebong bishwas muche fele je dhormiyo porichoy matro Pakistan-ke ekti rakhte pare.

Kintu, Bharat Poshchim Pakistan-ke purno vabe muchhe fele na. Bharat-er modhye shakha-guli bole labh-ta shudhu dite hobe, sthir, chirokalin shatru-ke purno vabe muchhe fele dite hobe. Washington ebong Beijing-er chap sheshe New Delhi-ke rokhe dilo. Itihashlok ei move niye aj-o jukti kore. Konek manush setake adarjyo noitikota hishebe prashansa kore je obhijojito abhijit muchhe fele, arekjon guli bole eta ekta boro sujog noshto kore Pakistan-ke abar shokti diye desher noshto kore. 1971 saler juddho Bharat-ke ekta bipod shomonnoyok ebong abhijukto muktidata hishebe porikkha kore, manusher kosto ebong boro rajnoitik bipod-er majhe bishleson kore. Seta poroborti South Asia-ke purno vabe porinoto kore, ajke dekha rajnoitik birodhline toiri kore.

Ummah Shokto: Kibhabe Islamic Bloc Bangladesh-ke Bichar Korlo

1971 sale, Bengali swadhinota juddho bishshor Islamic unnota-er boro shabder upor ekta noshto kore. Pakistan-er sainik shoshon bishshor Islamic shomuday-ke byakhya korechilo je eta loktantra, manusher odhikar, ba bhashar juddho noy. Er boddhe, eta bolechilo eta Islam-ke rokhar juddho je Awami League toiri korechilo, bishshor sobcheye boro Muslim rajjyo bhongar jonno.

Madhya Pashchim-er shashon ebong dritti andolan guli eta shikar korechilo karon eta tader dike bhalo vabe mel kore. Tara ekti kothin monobritti theke kaj korechilo je ekta Muslim-er shashon-er rajjyo-ke ekok rakha beshi guruttopurno, ekta jatigoto minority-er odhikar-er theke. Muslim Brotherhood-er moto goshti-guli Muslim vessel-ke rokhar upor kendro-baddho. Tara sob rajjyotantrer jonmo-ke ekta bibhhor, somprodaiyoto pashchimi truk mone kore. Tai, Ummah-er dharona Bengali-er biruddhe ekta hashar hote. Dhormiyo netritwo Bengali-ke bolechilo swadhinota chawa dhormiye biruddhe karon eta ekta Muslim rajjyo bhenge fele.

Folita chhilo East Pakistan-e lok-nirdosh-er somoy Islamic duniya-r ekta noshto, noshto chup. OIC sakriyo vabe Bangladesh-ke muche fele, lokkho Muslim-er pran-er theke ekta rajjyer bhougolik sima pasand kore. Bengali-der jonno, je prai Muslim-i chilo, eta ekti bhoyonkor aghat chhilo. Tara bujhechilo tader dhormiyo bandhota taderke bishshor Islamic duniya theke kono surakkha ba sompriti dey na. Jokhon beshi guruttopurno chhilo, tader mul sahajjo eshechilo Hindu somuho Bharat ebong somprodaiyoto, Soviet bloc theke.

Ei noshto ashol-e ashol na. Eta bishshor sthiti-hin Muslim manusher proti porichito poriborton-r sathe mel khay. Kurdish swadhinota juddho ekta porishkar protiti. Bengali-der moton, Kurdish-der o nijer bhasha ebong sangskriti ache. Kintu tader desh-er abhijog Muslim somuho desh-guli theke biruddhe: Turkey, Iran, Iraq, ebong Syria.

1971 sal ekta dhordo diye dekhe. 1971 sale 12 March-e Turkish sainik ekta memorandum diye nijei sarkar ke padachyuto kore, Kurdish-der biruddhe sidhdhanto kore, shromok-r party ke "bibhoktokari" kormo-er diye bondho kore ebong Kurdish pradesh-e martial law lagano. Eita Pakistani sainik-er ekta porishkar katha-chitrai: rajjyo abar toiri kora odhikar muche fele. Duti jagai, elite-guli dhormiyo niti byabohar kore purono bhougol porichoy-ta rokhe rakhar jonno.

Ekhane ekta bhishon sotti uthe: bishshor Islamic sompriti rajnoitik boktritay bhalo vabe kaj kore, kintu ashol manobodhikar sahajjo-er jonno kaj kore na. Dhormiyo dritti-guli bhougol porichoy-ke mone kore, lok-ke na. Tara Muslim-er biruddhe kaj kore vessel-ke rokhar jonno, seta-i okonno. Bangladesh-er jonno, 1971 saler bibhoktota sob kichhu porinoto kore. Setar fole praman kore je banchte somprodaiyoto juddho lage, tar nijer bhasha-er upor kendro-baddho, ebong dhormiyo bandhota-er theke beshi shareejer obostha-er upor kendro-baddho. Tara shikhechilo bishshor rajniti Realpolitik-er upor chole, jekhane swadhinta ebong sima-i ekmatro mull. Adhunik duniya rajjyo-ke rokhar jonno toiri, manusher na. Kurdish ba Bengali-ke dekho, shikkha-ta: Rajjyo Faith-er theke beshi shoktishali, ebong beshi nirdoshto.

Amerika: Naitikota ba Rajniti-er Bikri-r Itihas

Richard Nixon ebong Henry Kissinger 1971 sale East Pakistan-e ekti manusher bipod dekhenni. Tara ekta chessboard dekhlo. Nixon White House-er jonno Pakistan chhilo Beijing-er dorkari gupto setu. Nixon-ke Pakistani President Yahya Khan lage Mao Zedong-er dike rajnoitik jol rokhe rakhar jonno, se tar desk-e joma bhorapurno bhoyonkor report-guli muchhe fele.

Archer Blood, Dhaka-y US Consul General, chup thakte rajji hoyni. Se famous "Blood Telegram" pathiye, bishal, jwali birodhi pathan, bish-khokhok staff-er sakkhotite. Tara sidhdhanto sainik abhibhujito-ke genoside bole bolechilo ebong sarkarer chup-ke prashno korechilo. Nixon typical thana diye pratikriya korechilo: Blood-ke muchhe fele ebong Washington-e tule ane, Amerikari udhesho kothay ache seta poshthito kore.

Tarpor Nixon Amerikari bal diye USS Enterprise, boro nongedok carrier, Bangh-er dike pathiye. Eta chhilo rajnokitik, poranodiner shastro diplomacy je Bharat-ke bhoy diye rokhar jonno. Eta purno vabe befal hoy. Bharat khokharo noy. Er boddhe, Soviet Sangh turonto tader nijei nongedok carrier ebong submarine pathiye Vladivostok-er Pacific Fleet theke, Amerikari fleet-ke ghire roye.

White House puro duniyake ekta maha shakti bipod-er dike tule ane Pakistan-ke rokhar jonno, je rajjyo tader nijei nirdosh-ke nirdosh kore. Nixon-er 1971 saler ekta porishkar katha-chitrai set badhe dey ekta chirokalin obostha-er dike. Pakistan Amerikari rajnoitik nirdosh-er jonno abhijukto partner hoye thake. Arsho dhore Amerika roughly 70 billion dollar Pakistan-e invest kore, mudrar tara ekmushe shuru hoy 1980 sale, abar 9/11-er por. Coalition Support Funds blank check-er moto kaj kore counter-terrorism-er jonno, prai kono bhalo sharto chara. Aj-o, ei boro sahajjo legacy rajnoitik sthirata-ke bishal vabe bibhranto kore.

Nixon-er 1971 saler katha-chitra set badhe Amerikari rajniti-er jonno. Jokhon manusher odhikar ke "rajnokitik asset"-er shathe bikri koro, tahole ekti khokhro, bishal kharcha laga partnership kincho. Amerika China-er dike poth toiri kore, kintu South Asia-r naitik odhikar purno vabe bikri kore fele.

China: Bhougol Porichoy-r Abaduloto Rakhi

Beijing 1971 sale Bengali-der bipod-ke kono khamata dekhenni. Tara dekhlo Moscow-er shathe ekta boro chess match. Kremlin-er Bharat-ke sahajjo Chinese netritwo-ke laglo ekta porishkar khamota abhijog-er moto. Mao Zedong ebong tar andorider bhablo Bharat-er muktijuddho-er sathe mitrota Soviet-er agunir moto China ke dakshin theke chepe fellar jonno. Tai, China Pakistani shoshon-r Yahya Khan-ke sahajjo kore, biraat sainik pathar chhara.

Beijing boro poriman sainik shastro Pakistan-e pathiye Islamabad-er yuddho byabostha chalate. United Nations-e Chinese diplomat-guli din-raat kore Bangladesh-er swadhinota andolan-ke "Soviet shoshamijik abhijugto bibhoktota" hishebe dekhate. Tara bole eta swadhinta-er juddho noy, ekta obaid, bahirik abhijog ekta rajjyer biruddhe.

Pakistan-ke ekok rakha boro puroshkar chhilo. China-er jonno Islamabad chhilo Bharater khamota-er viruddhe ekmatro bharosayon balance ebong Washington-er dike gupto setu. Pakistan-er sahajjo chara Nixon-er China breakthrough purno vabe stuck hoye jeto.

Kintu, China nijei lroy ni. Soviet sainik Cheener shima-r upor porishkar chilen ebong Beijing janlo je Bharatiya sainik-ke akromon korle Red Army-er sathe bipod-er mukhe pora jabe. Er boddhe, ta shastro bikreta ebong rajnokitik gonjil hoye roilo, Pakistan-er sainik ke purbo-er purno porajoy muchhe fele.

Ei mitrota adhunik itihas-er sobcheye sthiro rajnokitik chukti-er modhye ekta hoye uthe. China bujhechilo Pakistan-ke rokhe, Bharat-ke sthir vabe byasto rakhte pare, tar sainik-ke shima-r upor boro angsho bindu korte. Aj, ei "sob-weather friendship" bishal arthonitik jol-er jol-e grow kore. CPEC-er modhye, Beijing roughly 65 billion dollar invest kore 2015 sale power plant, road, ebong Gwadar-er rajnokitik gamuk port-er jonno.

Arthonitik obostha porishkar kormo-er sathe. Anek din, China Pakistan-er ultimate lender hoye uthe. Jokhon Pakistan-er foreign exchange shukhiye jay, Beijing central bank swap ebong SAFE deposit diye rajjyo noshto hote dey na. 2026 sale shuru-er dike, Pakistan-er total bahirik rinn roughly 137 billion dollar ebong Chinese prashthan 22 shatangsho-er beshi.

Chinese bank-guli ei rinn muche fele na. Kichhu pashchimi sahajjo program-er biruddhe, Beijing "loan rollover" pasand kore. Tara shomoy badhiye dey, artho-sholliye Islamabad-e ar beshi byaj jome kore. Konek choto, byaj-mukto sarkari rinn muche fele, kintu boro power project-er shathe jukto commercial rinn abar ekton shokto roye.

2026 sale shuru-er dike, China Pakistan-er mul foreign direct investment-er strot, poricher shorir net FDI inflow-er adhik. Beijing-er obostha Pakistan-ke banchiye rakhar commitment purno. Islamabad-ke tar arthonitik jal-e bandhiye, China poranodiner Cold War mitrota-ke chirokalin rajnokitik obostha-ye rupoantor kore: tar Gwadar port surakkhito ebong ekta bharosayon, birodhi shosho bharata-ke pakhiye rakhe.

Pakistan: Nijer Khrunker Systemic Gothona

Pakistan-er 1971 saler bipod shudhu kono kharap sainik porajoy noy; eta chhilo ekta purno, upor theke nicher systemik noshto. Bish bochor beshi, ekta choto goshti sainik general, karmachari, ebong dhoni bhumihara desh-take bechok mojuri-er moto chalano. Tara 1970 saler sadharon nirbachon, desher itihas-er prothom prakritik vote, ekta nosto bodhag-er moto mone kore, proshno-tar na. Jokhon Sheikh Mujibur Rahman-er Awami League purno shonsodho labh kore, Poshchim Pakistan-er elite loktantra kaj korte dekhe na; tar bodle tar nijer astitwa bipod-er dike takalo.

Tader abostha thakar odhikar muche fele na, ebong Operation Searchlight bhoyonkor agun uthe. 1971 sale 25 March-er ratre shuru, eta kono sothyo sainik move noy. Eta chhilo sidhdhanto Bengali shomaj-ke katkar jonno tank ghusiye Dhaka University-te professor ebong chhatro-guli muchhe fele. Seta shasaner bahano muchhe fele, ekta bhoy-er campaign shuru kore je puro Bengali manobor-ke sidehanto kore, je shomohoto hoye shudhu upojatio swadhinta chara noy.

Rajnokitik dike, juddho-ta nijer toiri bipod. Poshchim Pakistan-er sreni bhablo je tar purbo dig-ke rokhe rakhte pare shudhu joruri obhijit diye. Tara bujhe nai je tader sainik-guli purno vabe alhada ebong birodhi, jol-bhorito, brishti-bhorito duniya-e alhada. Tara thik foreign abhijok-er moto byabohar korechilo nijer desher modhye.

Er boddhe, sainik guli purno board-er upor abar poriborton korte ekta birodhi, boro jukti shuru kore. 1971 sale 3 December-e, tar chengiz khan operation shuru kore, Bharatiya hawa-ghater upor joruri hawa akromon kore. Tara Israel-er 1967 sale-er famous surprise-er moto copy korte chey, ekta suddenly aghat diye Bharatiya hawa-bahini-ke muchhe fele. Amerikari "tilt" taderke ei abar shastro muchhe fele confidence diye. Washington-er rajnokitik gonjil ebong Bangh-e nongedok carrier-er promise General Yahya Khan-ke bishwas diye se bipod-er dike muchhe fele. Jukti purno vabe befal hoy; Bharatiya hawa-bahini move-ta aggei bujhe almost kono khoti pabe na, ebong Pakistan ghuntor modhye bipod-e dhorte hobe je bipod ta purno vabe sthir korte.

1971 sale 16 December-e pothom nirbodhoddho nirbodh, desh-take purno vabe bishonno kore. "Duto Rajyer Siddhanton", je dhormiyo porichoy-i Pakistan-er rajnoitik porichoy define kore, toettho-er bojha-er niche noshto hoye gelo. Ek Muslim somuho nijei Muslim-er shashon theke muchhe berote juddho korechilo. Monoshik bhoy 93,000 Pakistani sainik ke juddho-bondi hishebe dekhar sathe eshe. Anek pherote eshe sainik-guli tar career noshto ba reputation noshto hoye, ofr corps-er modhye sthiro birodh muchhe fele.

Loktantra toiri korte shikhar bodle, ei bhoy shashon elite-ke abar shoshon dike uthe. Aro rajjyotantrer muchhe yar bhoye, sarkar nijer desher adhunik andolan-ke notun nirdoshheto diye muchhe fele. Parajoy sainik-ke sthir, ultimate rajnokitik obostha-ye rakhe, noshto bhoy-er ekta gombhir sangskriti toiri kore je aj-o Islamabad-er rajnoitik ebong birohine rajniti kore.

Ei 1971-er por systemik poriborton-er angsho hishebe, rajjyo abar ekti kothin, conservative Islam-er ponrashon kore. General Zia-ul-Haq-er shashon porbe ei prokriya tez kore, prakritik darsotay Islam-er porishkar ponrashon sthir kore. Ei dhormiyo poriborton sainik-er jonno bhalo vabe kaj kore: ekta bhagna desh-er jonno ideolozhi er madhyom, ebong "porishkar" bhakti-er katha-chitra toiri kore, je somprodaiyoto Bengali-der sathe bibhinno. Sainik-er rajnoitik obostha dhormiyo daittobolita-er shathe muchhe fele, desher rajnoitik birodhi-ke effectively muchhe fele. Aro dhormiyo sobhota notun patrier porikkha hoye uthe.

Ei nijer poriborton bikri shuru kore bishal poriman bahirik mudra, je bibhinno uddesho-er sahajjo kore. Saudi Arabia Pakistan-er boom-er madrasa network-er dike boro poriman sahajjo pathiye. Ei invest shudhu class room-er modhye thake na. Pakistan ei ideolozhi assembly line, Amerikari ebong Saudi mudra-er sathe, bikri padoshi Afghanistan-er modhye ekta soshok gerilla bal toiri kore. Amerikari gyan byabostha prothome bhalo vabe mone kore karon eta Soviet-ke khoti kore, Islamabad-er madhyome mudra-er sahajjo pathiye Pakistani sainik-ke mujahideen chalate. Kintu ei komdino rajniti ekta monster toiri kore je sheshe nijer toirik-ke ghure ashe. Pakistan Afghanistan-er dike shosho sthir korte pare kintu bipod-tar fole bipod-er jonmo hoy. Amerika Soviet-ke mukti pete, kintu khali sthan-er fole bishsho noshto-er utthan bishsho bipod-er jonmo diye, bishshor pashchim-ke onkho din dhore jhokra dibe.

Pakistan-er derdin banchte thakar rajniti nirdoshheto-er upor bhitti kore. Tara shudhu mitro ney; tara mitro-ke muchhe fele. Islamabad pachash bochor dhore nijer dike South ebong Central Asia-r dorkari rajnoitik nirdoshheto hishebe toiri kore. Ei obostha Washington, Beijing, ebong Tehran-ke thanda dorbhota-er saath porishkar vabe byabohar korte dey. Tara ei somporko chirokalin mitrota noy, shudhu rajnoitik bikri-er moto mone kore.

Thakur porishkar vabe bojhai je Pakistani prashthan sobchye pratham rajjyo banchte beshi guruttopurno, kono mitro-er theke. Tara "upor diye noshto hoye uthe" ke ekta shilpo-er moto kore fele. Jokhon desh noshto hobar dike ba purno vabe antorjatik poradhibostha-er dike jay, tara arekta rajnoitik shakti khuje je Pakistan-ke noshto hote dey na. Nijer dike rajnokitik bottleneck hishebe toiri kore, tara bishsho shakti-ke baddho kore Pakistan-ke chalate mudra diye. Tara ekti system toiri kore je jekhane tader birodhi kormer kharcha mitro-er haate jay.

Soviet Chhaya

Soviet Sangh 1971 sale puro rajnoitik bipod hishebe kaj korechilo. Moscow-er jonno ei bipod sthaniyo Bengali swadhinta-er sathe kom lage; eta chhilo Washington ebong Beijing duto ke ek sathe muchhe fele. Kothin Sino-Soviet birodh Kremliner monobritti sashon korechilo. Pakistan Henry Kissinger-er Beijing-er gupto setu hishebe kaj korechilo, tai Soviet guli Islamabad-er kono bijoy ke tader nijer rajnoitik sthan-er upor sidhdhanto aghat mone korechilo. Tara urote hobe.

Moscow tader United Nations-er veto ke ekta rajnokitik hata-r moto byabohar kore. December-jure, Amerika ebong tar mitro-guli frantically jolito obostha-ke dhararResolution pathiye. Tara chahchilo juddho-sthiti sthir rakhte, effectively Pakistani bal-ke noshto hote muchhe fele Bharater kaj korte na pare. Soviet diplomat-guli eshe ei Resolution-guli muchhe fele. Ei obostha-diye, Moscow Bharatiya sainik-ke exactly shomoy diye je shomoy-ta Dhaka ke ghire roye ebong purno nirbodhoddho nirbodh muchhe fele dite.

Tarpor bipod diplomatic kotha-barta theke Bangh-er dike jure boro bipod-er dike jay. Jokhon President Nixon Task Force 74, nuclear-powered USS Enterprise-er netritwe, Bangh-e pathiye, se New Delhi-ke bhoy diye abhijit rokhar chahchilo. Soviet khokharo noy. Tara turonto tader nijei nongedok cruiser ebong submarine pathiye Vladivostok-er Pacific Fleet theke.

Ei abhijukto nongedok porishkar-er porishkhar ekta shikkha chhilo. Soviet jahaj-guli sidhdhanto American task force-er pother upor roye, ekta porishkar lal rekha toiri kore. Nixon White House-er dike borossho borossho message: jodi Amerikari sainik Pakistani bal-ke rokhar jonno hastokhep kore, tahole tara Soviet Sangher sathe sidhdhanto juddho-r modhye pravesh korbe. Bipod-er bhoye, bipod-er modhye porar bhoye, Amerikari jahaj pichone jay, shudhu ekta kothin pradarshini diye. Eta Bharatiya sainik-ke purbo-dig-e kono bahirik hastokhep chara kormo shesh korte diye.

Ei boro jukti Moscow ebong New Delhi-er modhye ekta gombhir, anek porjayer rajnokitik mitrota sthir kore. Setar fole praman kore je rajnoitik shakti-guli tader sobcheye guruttopurno labh rokhite pare ekta maha shaktir upor depend hoye. Bangladesh-er jonno, soviet-er nongedok gonjil chhilo janmo ebong lombo, raktakto obhijukto-er modhye porar modhye farak.

Israel: Gupto "Chup Mitro"

Israel-er chupsthito abhijog 1971 saler juddho-r sahajjo ekta porishkar obhigrahan. Jerusalem biporit South Asian bipod-ke dekhe nijer labher lens-er dike. Pakistan bhongar sahajjo arthat ekta birodhi Arab bloc-er boro khamota ke komiye. Israel-ke ekta sujog diye Bharat-er moto utthan rajjyo-er sathe mitrota korte ebong ekta birodhi-er rajnokitik gonjil muche fele.

Ei gupto mitrota shastro-er sathe. Israel bhoyonkor sainik shastro, bishesh kore boro 160mm mortar ebong bishesh golobar, sidhdhanto Bharater haate pathiye. Tara eta gupto tritiyo-pokhker madhyome pathiye, porishkar erakom lage na. Shastro-er baire, Israeli gyan guli sidhdhanto Bharatiya sainik ke obhijit kormo-er sathe sahajjo kore purbo-dik-er obostha-er sathe.

Ei gupto yuddho-kalir mitrota Bharat ebong Israel-er modhye ajker boro, bahu-pokhher rajnokitik mitrota-er bhitti toiri kore. 2026 sale, South Asian padoshi-der modhye porisar bishal. Bharat ebong Israel tader mitrota "Special Strategic Partnership for Peace, Innovation and Prosperity" hishebe unnoto kore. Prime Minister Modi-r porishkar visit-er somoy, duto rajjyo adhunik shastro production, AI-driven defense, ebong cybersecurity-er shathe jukto hoy. Tara shudhu shastro alhada kore na; tara milke toiri kore ebong boshpo kore, Israel-er technology ebong Bharater boro-shorir shilpo milke.

Bangladesh, erakom, purno alhada rajnokitik duniya-e banchhe. Israel 1971 sale Bangladesh-er muktir prothom chinhon kora rajjyo-gulir modhye ekta chhilo, kintu duto rajjyo purno poradhibostha. Dhaka tader birohine rajniti OIC-er kothin rajniti-er sathe bondho rakhe. 2026 sale shuru-er dike, Bangladeshi sarkar Israel-er bhougol porichoy-er upor abashoi bishoyer dike chokh rakhe. Tara 2021 sale Israeli passport-er upor probas nisedh muchhe fele, kintu rajnokitik obostha abar shuru-er moto sthir roye. Bangladesh ekta bishal bhougol arthonitik engine toiri korechilo, kintu tar rajnoitik porichoy noishchoy kore je Israel-er sakkhor porichoy-ta protinidhi hote pare na.

Bharater biruddhe, Bharat bahu-madhuri-er shilpo master kore. New Delhi Israel-er sathe misail technology milke toiri kore ebong Tehran ebong shomriddho Gol-er rajjyo-er sathe bhalo rajnokitik jol rokhe rakhe. Tara ei somporko-guli alhada, swatantrik stambh hishebe mone kore, tader nijer rajnoitik labh-er biruddhe muchhe fele. Eta ekta jotil, purno obhigrahan-chara khamoter upor bhitti abhijog, je Pakistan ebong Bangladesh-ke ekti aro kothin rajnokitik obostha-er dike porishkar vabe bhorti kore.

Angsho II:

Systemic Poriborton ebong Porichoyer Bipod

Purono bibhajito rajjyer duti angshor birodh adhunik itihas-er sobcheye kothin arthonitir shikkha toiri kore. 1971 sale, Poshchim Pakistan purbo-ke shudhu ekta lute arthonitik strot hishebe mone korechilo. Aj, porishkar birodh: purono abhijukto-er upor ponrabar, puroner theke beshi sthir, prodhukari, ebong arthonitir dike beshi noishthik hoye utheche. Bangladesh global garment banijjye ekta sthir, boro engine toiri kore, sikkha, jiboner lomba somay, ebong mohila shromi obhijukti-er boro unnoyon toiri kore.

Dhormiyo aj-o boro bhoomika play kore, kichhu Bangladeshi nagorik-ke Pakistan-er saath ekta birodhi, obhigrahan-chara sangskritik sneho rakhte encourage kore, tader purbopuron-er sathe boro obhijit muchhe fele. Kintu, Bangladesh-er arthonitik bhitti tike somprodaiyoto, adhunik shomaj-er dike poth toiri kore, jodi rajnoitik shreni eta korte chaile.

Pakistan, er boddhe, ekta bhagna modhel-er upor tike, je setar poriborton korte parbe na. Desh-ta banchte pare na jodi setar rajnokitik obsession thake je desh-take unnoyon muchhe fele.

Pakistan-er rajjyo gothona puro vabe rajnokitik shakti-er dike toiri, je shastro shakti ke manusher obhigrahan-er theke beshi guruttopurno mone kore. Jokhon sainik elite-er obostha desher arthonitir boro angsho-er upor, desh-ta abar ekta sthir, porishkar shilpo toiri korte parbe na. Ei chirokalin bahirik sahajjo-er abhijog rajjyo-er DNA-ye bonded. Chaile Amerikari sainik mudra, chaile Chinese porishkar rinn, chaile Saudi tel rinn, mudra-ta sustainable arthonitir jonno eshe na; eta sthir birodh-er chidro muchhe fele. Eta ekta purno obhijit-chara byabostha: jokhon Pakistan-er rajjyo dekhe jeno muchhe fele, tader bahirik rinn-der obostha ar beshi motivate hoy ar ekta boro mudra diye rajnoitik bipod muchhe fele.

Boro bhoomi ebong jubok somuho-ke arthonitik labh hishebe thakle-o, Pakistan abar prai sob somoy puroner porajito-er pichone pore. Ei durashoyol obostha ebong sthir birodh banchte porichito dhormiyo sahajjo-er ekjon ekak rajjyo hishebe porichoy kore.

1971 sale Bangladesh-er jonmo shuru hoyeche lute-er viruddhe sidhdhanto, bhoy-er sathe. Bish bochor beshi, Poshchim Pakistan purbo-ke captive market-er moto mone korechilo, tader boro jute export-er mudra lute Poshchim-er industrial hub-er jonno, Bengali hridoy bhoomi-er kosto-er sathe. Jokhon 1970 saler nirbachon Awami League-ke prakritik loktantra-er udhesho diye, Poshchim Pakistan-er elite sainik jorur khati-er bodle jore kore. Operation Searchlight shesher bhoyonkor khati chhilo. Sainik-er systemik chhatro, intellektual, ebong Hindu minority-ke muchhe fele rajnoitik bibad-ke sidhdhanto banchte juddho-er dike rupoantor kore.

Jokhon golabar shuru shesh hoy, desh-ta purno vabe jole porinoto. Infrastructure bhagna, samajik fabric chire gelo, ebong manusher kosto bishal chhilo. Lakh-khokhok lok morar baire, notun rajjyo ekta bhoyonkor shasaner fankha face korechilo, kono kaj-er kormachari na, sthir sainik netritwo na, kono arthonitik reserve na. Prothom diner din-e boro durashoyol, bhoyonkor durashoyol, ebong desh-take purno vabe notun kore toiri kora kosto-r abhigrahan.

Arthonitik labh aste aste eshe, global garment banijjyer upor bhitti. Ei shilpor poriborton lokkho mohila krishak-ke shromik theke global export shakti-er solid backbone-e rupoantor kore. GDP unnoyon prai somosto padoshi-er upore, kintu systemik obostha bhitorer dike abar bishal durbol. Adhunik Bangladesh ekti birodhi, asubidhopurno madhyam obostha: dekhte arthonitik bijoyer golpo, kintu thamete protinidhi.

Infrastructure-er dike takan. Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant-er moto project, je dashok dhore Russian contractor-er sathe stuck, ba Dhaka-er sthir, noshto-tar moto traffic bipod, ekta rajjyo-ke dekhay je boro abhijog-ke purna korte parbe na. Desh-ta ekta birodhi-er madhyome kaj kore je raw gas export kore abar Singapore theke refined fuel import kore, ei abhyash tader bishal hard currency reserve-ke druto kore fele. Beshi kharcha bahirik rinn-er duniya-e, ekta notun subway line toiri kora lage puro porjayer.

Mukti-er por, adhunik rajjyoder bhitorko bishyal abhigrohon dorkar. Ghoriye gas porishkar kore, bhagna subway project-ke noishthik kore, ebong bahirik rinn-er upor depend muchhe fele - eita ekta rationol rajjyer baseline udhesho. Jodi sarkar adhin shakti erokom bhabe dhormiyo obostha-er sathe porishkar kore, desh-ta pash-diner modhye alhada hote.

Prakritik vabe, ei poriborton conservative goshti-ke bhoyonkor vabe muchhe fele je status quo-er sathe dhoni. Desh-take samajik porichoy-er theke purno vabe porichit rajnoitik obostha-ye rupoantor kora hobe khokhro ebong volatile. Eta lombo somoyer samajik swasthya ke immediate rajnoitik banchte theke beshi guruttopurno mone kore, tara rajnoitik elite-ke dorkar.

Erakom, somajik bhougol poriborton hote dekhe jekhane somprodaiyoto kothin sompodaiyotar utthan muchhe fele. 1971 sale-er mul rajnoitik porichoy, je bhashik gourab ebong kothin somprodaiyotar prashansa korechilo, aj abar conservative dhormiyo orthodoxy-er utthan-er sathe jukto. Loktontra-er prothokkhon, nostikota, ba madhyom toloshor rajnoitik jayga murore geche. Minority goshti, bishesh kore Hindu somuho, aste aste shima-ke muchhe fele, rajnoitik shreni dhormiyo base-ke sahajjo korte. Dhormiyo shikkha-prashthan aj mukti juddher por-er din theke beshi sangskritik prabhab royeche.

Ei obosthate boro birodh ache je bhoyonkor dhormiyo sobhota ebong desher abhishar dorkar adhunik biggan-er shikkha-r modhye. Konek classroom-e, biggan-er class dhormiyo doktrin-er abhijog theke kom. Ei systemik noshto ekta shromik-goshti toiri kore je proyogik innovation-er dharadhari chokh-er abhabe. Desh-ta Singapur theke refined fuel abar import kore, raw gas export kore, ei birodhi tader hard currency reserve-ke druto muchhe fele.

Rajnoitik shreni ei alochana muchhe fele. Tara soman-er chayga-er theke ekta shanto, manoniyo shomaj pasand kore. Jot din porjonto sashon dhormiyo abhigrahan ke somner dike byabohar kore, desh unnoyon-er khamata theke kom kore fele, ekta noshto, lukewarm sthan-e stuck. Desh-ta 1971 sale-er joler muche fele banchto, kintu abar ekta noshto, lukewarm sthan-e stuck.

bdatheism.title: Nastikota ┃ Vanga Vitanastika
bdatheism.body:
Prothom Angsho:

Shuru Ebong Prachin Projukti

Atheism-er Shuru

Atheism-er ghrinmo itihas ache je aage theke adhunik biggan ba rajnoitik unnotti theke o purono. Itihaser dike, devtader proti abishwas toiri chintadhara theke o purono. Prachin sabhyotar modhye, byakti guli prashna korechilo divyo kothaboli guli ebong prokritik byabashayin diye byabostha toiri korechilo. Ei shondeho bancha thakar toettho darshay je Atheism kono notun intellectual abriti nooi, tahole mante hobe je eta manusher gobeshonar ekti abritik byabokriti. Kintu eta sobi chokkhuner upor depend kore, rajnoitik gathan, ebong abishwas prokasher bhoy er upor.

Prachin Projukti: Prachin Jagater Shondeho

Prachin Meditereniyan-e, Grik chintabider modhye Demokritos, Epikouros, ebong Lukretios guli protichchobito procholito abishwas guli toiri korechilo. Tara protibad korechilo devtar karjyoguli ke ebong prokritik byabashayin diye kothaboli toiri korechilo je guli ke devtar karjyoguli hishebe mone korechilo. Tader kaj sobi shokkho bhabe devtader protyakhare noichilen, kintu eta divyo byabosthar upor depend kora theke bancher ekti prokar.

Dakshin eshiar dike, Charvaka skul ekti poribortik byabostha toiri korechilo je pabitra toettho ke noshto korechilo ebong pore porer jibon ke protyakhare korechilo. Tara bolechilo je chetana shorir theke uthe ebong shorirer saath noshto hoy. Joto-tuku mukhya bhabe tarkaroktoder lekha theke bancha thake, Charvaka chinta darshay je Atheist tottho abritik vabe bhinno bhinno chintadhara theke uthe. Ei prochom abishwas guli chhoto chhoto boitok dol theke ber kora hoyeche. Tara protichchobito dhormiyo khamota ke protibad korechilo kintu boro shamohik andolan ba protishthan gathan toiri kore ni.

Prachin Sabhyotar Modhye Abishwas

Indus Ghoti ebong Vanga: Indus Ghoti sabhyota lekha dharmiyo toettho nei, tahole koyekjon scholar mone kore je prokritik bishwaser dike kom guruttopurno chhilo. Atheism-er prodhan praman na holeo, ei abhav suggest kore je prachin Dakshin Eshiari shomaj guli sobi dhormiyo tottho ke kendro kore nai. Vanga-e, prachin dhormiyo kormokolap miliye chilo animism, porbapokder pujo, ebong sthanik devta. Ei byabostha guli shondeho-thakar jaiga diyechilo, karon bisshas prokritik ghotoner saath juro, sthir dhormiyo tottho diye na.

Mesopotamia: Mesopotamia sahityote prochur prachin devtar noitik byabashayiner kotha ache. "Noshto Manusher Kothashilpo" toettho darshay je proshno guli kothin, ebong "Babylonian Theodicy" devtar byabostha ke noitik tottho diye noshto kore. Ei toettho darshay je shondeho o bhitorer dhormiyo shomajeo chilo.

Prachin Misir: Misir lekhaguli prochur devtar byabosthar birodh darshay. Ekti majhi porjayer kobi lekheche ekjon byakti kivabe devtader byabashayin ke protyakhare kore ebong mrityu ke shunyote ferar sombhabona mone kore. Shokkho bhabe Atheist na holeo, ei guli byaktigoto shondeho ke darshay.

Prachin China: China intellectual byabostha toettho guli prokritik chintadhara toiri korechilo. Konfuchius noitikota ebong shason ke kendro korechilo, divyo hastakshep diye na. Laozi ebong Zhuangzi byabostha ke shadharon prokritik tottho hishebe bolechilo. Poriborton, Wang Chong shokkho bhabe divyo prodotti ke noshto korechilo, prokritik tottho diye.

Prachin Griko: Grik abishwas darsik ebong somohik chilo. Atomist guli prokritik byabostha toiri korechilo. Epikouros bolechilo je devta thakleo, tara manusher karjyer opor byabahito na. Lukretios prokritik byabashayin diye prokritik ghotona ke byabashayin korechilo. Prokashe tottho guli ebong natok guli dhormiyo khamota ke shadharon korechilo.

Islam Shonacharshil: Islam Shonacharshil kal theke, chintabider modhye Ibn al-Rawandi ebong Abu Bakr al-Razi guli nubuwat ebong wahiy ke prashna korechilo. Tara lekha guli chup kore cholto ebong prae protyakhare through bancha thakto, kintu eta darshay je abishwas beshi dhormiyo shahajjyo kal eo bancha thake.

Dutiyo Angsho:

Itihaser Pariborton Ebong Poriborton

Modhyojug: Jokhon Shondeho Bokhokarok Hoyechilo

Dhormiyo protishthan guli rajnoitik khamota jokhon jome jay, tokhon prokashe abishwas bhoyer kaaj hoye uthe. Europe-e, Atheism-er abhishkar rajnoitik hater moto byabohar kora hoy. Prochondo shondebok guli nijer tottho chupiye rekhe chilo codified bhasha diye ba byaktigoto chithi diye. Islamik khettre, abishwas darsik ebong chikitsa tottho e bancha thake kintu prokashito na hoy.

Illumination: Abishwas Prokasher Kormokolap

Illumination Atheism prokasher dike ekti boro poriborton chinhay. Lekhon, biggan, ebong rajnoitik tottho er unnotti diye beshi bisharok procholon hoy. Chintabider modhye d'Holbach, Hume, ebong Feuerbach guli dhormiyo byabashayin ke protibad korechilo ebong noitikota ebong somohik gathaner jonno secular byabostha toiri korechilo. Tader kaj Atheism-ke ekta swikrito darsik sthan hishebe uthe ashte sahayata korechilo.

Bish Shoto: Rajjyer Niti Hisebe Atheism

Bish Shoto e, Atheism koyekti desher rajjyer idiolozhi hoye uthe. Soviot Union Marxism-Leninism niti ghire nilo, ebong China ebong Albania-eo erokom byabostha uthe. Ei byabostha mukhya bhabe rajnoitik hater moto kaj korechilo, darsik Atheism diye na. Ei shoshon guli shikkha ebong ain diye secular niti procholon korechilo, prachin dhormiyo byabosthar saath birodhi hoye.

Tritiyo Angsho:

Jogotik Bhoogol Ebong Idiolozhir Poriborton

Islamik Bhumikar Modhye Chapotir Niche Atheism

Musulman sromohinir deshe Atheism-er unnotti ache ain, somajik, ebong rajnoitik chap diye toiri hoyeche. Ei khettre, prokashe abishwas beshi byaktigoto ba chhupiye rakha hoy karon beshi bhoy ache.

  • Bangladesh: Bangladesh-er secular sotontro sriti birodhi ache tar bortoman obostha, jekhane atheist guli somojik boiddho, ebong koyekkhon khatarnak ojhatara face kore. Prokashe atheist chinhonito lekhok guli historik vabe bhishon bhoy face korechilo. Folita, Atheism prae prateek, byabashayin, ebong digital golpo diye prokashito hoy.
  • Pakistan: Pakistan-er dokkhota birodhi ain guli dhormiyo abishwas prokasher jonno bhishon dandar prokash kore. Prokashe atheist kom, ebong beshir bhag atheist anonim bhabe online shamuh e participate kore.
  • Saudi Arabia ebong Gulf: Saudi Arabia-e, Atheism kanoonig vabe durniti hishebe dhora hoy. Atheist guli byaktigoto bhabe kaj kore, prokashe kom. Ar gulf rajjer moton porishkar, shondeboshili thake kintu chhupiye thakta hoy.
  • Iran: Iran-er intelektual itihas e darsik shondeboshili ache. Kintu bortoman simaboddho guli encourage kore atheist guli nijer tottho sahityo ebong sangskritik byabashayin diye sahaj kore prokash korte.
  • Misir: Misir e Atheism niye prokashe tottho guli prochur, prae rajnoitik obishkar shomoye. Ei khulono prochur somoy noi karon ain ebong somajik chap ache.

Antitheism Andolan Ebong Dhormiyo Swatantratar Protibodh

Unish-sat shoto ebong bish shoto e, Atheism aro kothin bhabhe prokashito hoy. Rajnoitik radikal guli Bakunin ebong Marx bolechilo je dhormo somajik swargolokke shokkho kore ebong manusher swatantrata baadhhok kore. Tader tottho byabashayin shamuh ebong rationalist dol guli ke prabhavit korechilo.

Adhunik kal e, byabosthit Atheism sobhosha, lekhapon, ebong prokashe andolan diye dekha peta. Richard Dawkins, Sam Harris, ebong Christopher Hitchens guli bolechilo je dhormo ke kono vabe swatantrata dewa uchit na, shudhu shongskriti ba pavitro tottho diye na. Tara bolechilo je dhormiyo prodotti guli ke anya idiolozhi byabosthar moto e porishkare kora dorkar.

Dhormiyo Swatantrata Ebong Punorgoner Abhidhan

Bortoman atheist guli beshi prashna kore "dhormiyo swatantrata" ke kanuni goner dike. Pradhan tottho ei je prati dritter byabostha, cha devta, bhuter, byobosthit urja, ba kichhui na, take keu soman mone kore. Totthoguli bole je bortoman byabostha dhormiyo ke anya dritter theke beshi rakhi kore, nonreligious ba kalponik dritter theke na.

Prosthabito bikalper modhye ache "bisshaser swatantrata" ba "kalponir swatantrata", je guli sob dritter byabostha ke boro goner poriborton e dhore, biswas byabostha, kothaboli byabostha, noitik byabostha, ebong chinhota byabostha. Ei punorgoner uddeshyo hoche ki sabar kache kanuni aboman byabostha soraben, ebong dhormiyo ebong nonreligious shamuh er modhye lardho komaben.

Shesh Kotha: Ekti Andolan Jeta Ajkeo Unnotti Hoche

Atheism poriborton hoye ache obosthar saath jekhane dhormiyo khamota ain, shikkha, ebong prokashe jibon ke ghire thake. Eta darsik hoy jokhon intellectual swachchhata dorkar, kothin hoy jokhon dhormiyo swatantrata sthir hoy, ebong chhupiye thakto jokhon prokash khatarnak. Digital chokkhu Atheism-er tottho aro bishal koreche, bhinno simaboddhor modhye participate korte dite.

Atheist ebong Antitheism andolan bhinno somajik ebong rajnoitik obostha onujayi unnotti hoye. Tara bhinno uddeshyo poshon kore, shikkhar poriborton, noitik saman, ebong sangskritik byabashayin sahito. Bhinno matbhed thakleo, ei andolan guli bisshas ebong abishwas ek rokhom mone kore tader prati poriborton chahay. Atheism-er poriborton darshay boro shomajik poriborton, ebong bortoman tottho guli, odhikar, chinhota, ebong intelektual swatantrata ke ghire prasongik ache.

fil.title: Dorshon ┃ Vanga Vitanastika
fil.lead: Proshno, uttor ebong tader pashonkar karon gulor odhyapon
fil.body:
Mul Dharabaha:

Gobeshonar Ghorshon

Philosophy shuru hoy jokhon porichito byabashayin guli aar jeno porishkar na. Ekta biswas je ekhon sob mone hoto chilo, sheta shuru kore norte. Ekta niti je shobai mone koto chhilo, sheta ekhon jeno pash theke nilo. Ekta shahoj proshno chup kore boshar na mone kore. Ei ghorshoner shomoy guli shurute ekta ongoner prothom, je je kotha gobeshona ke guruttopurno mone kore, bipod na.

Etar modhye, philosophy ekta mulltottho guli ke investigate kore je manusher chintadhara ke ghire rekheche. Tottho, tottho, tottho, tottho, tottho, tottho — ei toettho guli shiri kore. Ei toettho guli sajja na. Eta darshay je manusher kivabe jukti kore, kivabe prodhan praman ke byabashayin kore, ebong kivabe byabostha ke bujhe. Tara soyger obhidhha hote uthe je theke borer unnotti hoyeche.

Prachin chintabider philosophy ke biggan theke alada kore ni. Tara proshna korechilo je byabostha ki diye toiri, poriborton kivabe ghote, akash kivabe cholche, ebong shorir kivabe kaj kore. Tara byabostha, tottho, ebong kalpana diye kaj korechilo aagei lab diye na. Bhoutik tottho shuru hoy chintadhara toettho diye. Jibbiggan shuru hoy poriborton ghotona diye. Monobiggan shuru hoy chetana porishkare korte. Logic, goner totthosadhona ebong computer tottho er bhumika, tottho shuru hoy tottho gobeshonar poriborton.

Ei shuru tottho guruttopurno. Bigganer poddhoti, prae, byabaharik obhidhha tottho. Ei tottho je prodotti porishkharjoggo, hypotenuse guli porishkharjoggo hote hobe, ebong prodhan praman abarotito hote hobe — eta philosophy theke utheche. Biggan ekhono theke esheche na. Eta tottho, prodhan praman, tottho, ebong byabashayin tottho theke utheche.

Philosophy bigganer noitik pash ta o ghire rekheche. Autonomy, responsibility, odhikar, ebong justice guli bigganer kormokolap ke ghire rekheche. Sotti porishkar, gonobigyan, chikitsar tottho, ebong lokniti sob tottho tottho ebong khotir poriborton. Philosophy chara, biggan kaj hoy kintu drishti noi.

Byabostha:

Mul Tottho Ebong Byabostha

Koyekti mul byabostha philosophy-ke porishkar kore.

Rationalism bole je tottho prokritik byabostha ke porishkar korte pare. Eta gathan tottho guli toiri kore ebong jukti dhore. Empiricism bole je gyan onubhob ebong byabostha theke uthe hobe. Eta manusher ke byabostha porishkare poriborton korte bole. Skepticism proshna kore je koto gyan sambhab, ebong prodotti ke onurodh kore tar sthiti ke porishkare korte.
